name: MindKosh Pixora
description: Free image, PDF, passport photo, text and developer tools in your browser.

name: Image Editor
description: Convert, resize and adjust images in your browser. Download edited photos in supported formats.

name: Image Converter
description: Convert images between supported formats with adjustable output settings and batch downloads.

name: Image Resizer
description: Resize images using presets or custom pixel dimensions before downloading your photos.

name: Image Enhancer
description: Adjust photo brightness, contrast and sharpness, then preview and download the edited image.

name: Passport Photo Maker
description: Crop a person from a photo and arrange passport photos in multiple sizes on printable sheets.

name: PDF Merge
description: Combine multiple PDF files into one document in your browser.

name: Watermark Remover
description: Cover selected areas in images and PDFs, or remove watermark text and header graphics from supported documents.

name: HTML Code Generator
description: Create, preview and download responsive HTML pages using configurable templates.

name: PDF Editor
description: Add text, cover areas, rotate, reorder and delete PDF pages. Exported pages are flattened.

name: Document Translator
description: Extract and translate PDF, DOCX, TXT and HTML text using available browser models or free online services.

name: Text Tools
description: Count words, change text case, clean text and find or replace phrases in your browser.

name: Calculators
description: Calculate percentages, GST, EMI and BMI, or convert everyday units.

name: Developer Tools
description: Format JSON, encode Base64 and URLs, generate hashes, passwords and UUIDs, and convert colours.

name: AI Background Tools
description: Remove or change photo backgrounds and export subject masks using browser AI tools.
